title: Starfield with nebula gas and dust lanes
purpose: Generate tileable maps of a star field: blackbody-coloured stars with halos and diffraction spikes over glowing nebula gas and dark dust lanes, with an emissive map holding the light. Use for space backdrops, sci-fi skies, starship windows and planetarium props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python starfield_nebula.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: bright_stars
parameters.meaning: Share of bright stars: 0 nearly all faint, 1 many bright ones.

parameters.name: star_size
parameters.meaning: Apparent star size; brighter stars are drawn larger.

parameters.name: spikes
parameters.meaning: Four-point diffraction spikes on bright stars, 0 none.

parameters.name: star_temperature
parameters.meaning: Typical star temperature in kelvin: low gives orange stars, high blue-white ones.

parameters.name: nebula
parameters.meaning: Amount and brightness of glowing gas.

parameters.name: nebula_scale
parameters.meaning: Cloud features across the tile; larger values give smaller clouds.

parameters.name: swirl
parameters.meaning: Domain warping that pulls the gas into filaments and swirls.

parameters.name: dust
parameters.meaning: Dark dust lanes that dim the gas and the stars behind them.

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.meaning: Share of stars gathered in a cluster around the middle of the tile.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and the light in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Deep field: many faint stars over faint violet and blue gas.

presets.name: emission_nebula
presets.description: Bright red and teal gas torn by dark dust lanes, fewer stars.

presets.name: star_cluster
presets.description: A dense cluster of hot bright stars with diffraction spikes and little gas.

presets.name: dark_void
presets.description: Sparse cool stars and faint brown dust in a nearly empty field.

limits: A flat tile, not an equirectangular or cube-map sky: wrapped on a sphere it pinches toward the poles, and repeating it shows the same stars again. Star colours come from blackbody temperatures through an approximate colour-matching fit, not from a catalogue; brightness, sizes and spikes are artistic, and stars smaller than a pixel fade out at small output sizes. Gas and dust are noise, not a radiative transfer model. Height and normals are shallow and only follow the gas; occlusion is a stand-in from the dust. The emissive map holds colour only, so the engine sets the emission strength.
technique_references: Planck's law integrated against a multi-lobe Gaussian fit of the CIE 1931 colour-matching functions
CIE XYZ to linear sRGB conversion
Gaussian point spread with halo and diffraction spikes
Domain-warped fractional Brownian motion for gas
Ridged multifractal noise for dust lanes
Light summed in linear units and encoded as sRGB
